description: This file defines the NormalizeRecordsSchedulerJob class, which extends the SchedulersJob class. It provides methods to schedule a normalization job for record repair (specifically UTF encoding repairs) within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods to create and queue a job, as well as to retrieve the job bean.

classes.name: NormalizeRecordsSchedulerJob
classes.description: A scheduler job class responsible for initiating a record normalization process, specifically repairing UTF encoding issues, by submitting jobs to the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM job queue.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Static method that sets repair status, creates a new job instance, encodes data, assigns a user ID, and submits the job to the job queue to perform normalization tasks.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Static method that retrieves the scheduler job bean for the job with the identifier 'repair-utf-encoding'.
